record.what_it_does: Ecwid (by Lightspeed) is a hosted e-commerce platform whose REST API lets apps manage a merchant's store data, including products, orders, customers, discounts, and storefront settings.
record.auth_notes: OAuth2 is used for public/external apps installed on third-party merchants' stores (POST to https://my.ecwid.com/api/oauth/token/{store_id} to exchange a code for a token). For a single store you own, Ecwid also lets you skip the OAuth flow entirely and copy a pre-generated 'secret' or 'public' Bearer access token straight from the custom app's dashboard; that token is then sent as a Bearer token on every REST call. Tokens do not expire while the app remains installed.
record.access_notes: Anyone can sign up for an Ecwid store and instantly get a working secret access token for a private/custom app on that one store (self-serve, free). But a multi-user agent toolkit needs a public app using OAuth2 so it can connect to many merchants' stores, and publishing/distributing such an app requires Ecwid's app validation process (submitting an App Readiness Form plus a screencast, with a stated 1-3 business day review) before the app can go live in the App Market or be installed broadly.
record.main_blocker: Public/multi-store distribution requires Ecwid's app validation review; only single-store private apps get instant self-serve credentials
